Sub FormatReport()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Summary")
    ws.Range("A1:D1").Font.Bold = True
    ws.Columns("A:D").AutoFit
    MsgBox "Report formatted", vbInformation
End Sub
-----
Function TotalRevenue(rng As Range) As Double
    Dim cell As Range
    Dim total As Double
    For Each cell In rng
        If IsNumeric(cell.Value) Then total = total + cell.Value
    Next cell
    TotalRevenue = total
End Function
-----
Private Sub Workbook_Open()
    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = Cells(Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    Range("A2:A" & lastRow).Sort Key1:=Range("A2"), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlNo
End Sub
-----
Sub ExportCsv()
    Dim fileName As String
    fileName = ThisWorkbook.Path & "\export_" & Format(Date, "yyyymmdd") & ".csv"
    ActiveSheet.SaveAs fileName:=fileName, FileFormat:=xlCSV
End Sub
-----
Sub SendReminder()
    Dim outlookApp As Object
    Set outlookApp = CreateObject("Outlook.Application")
    With outlookApp.CreateItem(0)
        .To = "team@example.com"
        .Subject = "Weekly reminder"
        .Body = "Please update the tracker."
        .Display
    End With
End Sub
